builder: an app's first build installs Rust and the build tools on its own row, and asks its questions where every question is -- Enter on an app whose compiler is not set up opened a full page for the install that flickered over the menu. Now the private Rust (and on macOS the wait for Apple's installer, on Linux the distribution's packages, on Windows the Build Tools, SDK and CUDA) installs first thing in the app's background build, on its row: "⠴ installing Rust ━━━━──── 40%" ("installing build tools" for several), then downloading and compiling; c cancels it like any build. Only the questions come in front, as rows above the rule: Rust's (private or the installed one), asked only when a compatible Rust is already installed on the machine, else the private one installs without asking; Apple's tools ("install them", "accept the license", "check again", "cancel"); the packages' sudo; on Windows the local AI and vendor consent questions ("read the agreements" opens them in the browser). The work pages are gone from both TUIs. makepad.sh words the Rust question like the Windows TUI. Checked in a pty: the shell and the Rust TUI installing Rust inline after the question, then downloading and compiling; the shell with Apple's tools missing (DEVELOPER_DIR pointed at a folder that does not exist): the question, cancel ("Nothing was installed."), install (the row waits, "installing Apple's tools") and, once the folder appears, going on to compiling by itself; cancelling while it waits; no installer dialog from startup. The license-pending case needs Apple's own tools to say so and was not simulated; the Windows questions compile but ran only on this Mac's code paths
